hints.title: Filter for Paid Conversion
hints.text: Only users who have at least one record with activity type paid are considered converted and eligible for reporting.

hints.title: Conditional Aggregation
hints.text: Use conditional statements within aggregate functions to compute average duration separately for free trial and paid periods.

hints.title: Rounding and Sorting
hints.text: Round both averages to two decimal places and order the final output by user identifier in ascending order.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    user_id,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN activity_type = 'free_trial' THEN activity_duration END), 2) AS trial_avg_duration,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN activity_type = 'paid' THEN activity_duration END), 2) AS paid_avg_duration
FROM UserActivity
WHERE user_id IN (
    SELECT user_id 
    FROM UserActivity 
    WHERE activity_type = 'paid'
)
GROUP BY user_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Single table scan with hash aggregation per user.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Joining the full table on itself repeatedly produces an unnecessary Cartesian product.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping directly avoids temporary join tables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use conditional aggregation inside AVG to handle multiple lifecycle stages cleanly.

solutions.code:
SELECT 
    user_id,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN activity_type = 'free_trial' THEN activity_duration END), 2) AS trial_avg_duration,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN activity_type = 'paid' THEN activity_duration END), 2) AS paid_avg_duration
FROM UserActivity
WHERE user_id IN (
    SELECT user_id 
    FROM UserActivity 
    WHERE activity_type = 'paid'
)
GROUP BY user_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC;

SELECT 
    user_id,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN activity_type = 'free_trial' THEN activity_duration END)::numeric, 2) AS trial_avg_duration,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN activity_type = 'paid' THEN activity_duration END)::numeric, 2) AS paid_avg_duration
FROM UserActivity
WHERE user_id IN (
    SELECT user_id 
    FROM UserActivity 
    WHERE activity_type = 'paid'
)
GROUP BY user_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC;
